en-US.description: A desktop AI gateway with one local endpoint that converts between three protocols.
en-US.longDescription:
Silk is an AI multi-model gateway running on your desktop (Tauri 2 + Rust/Axum). All the hassles you face when managing multiple AI providers—incompatible protocols, scattered API keys, or an entire service crashing due to rate limiting—are solved with a single local HTTP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:1877.

✨ Feature Highlights

- 🌐 Unified Access — Your ChatBox, LobeChat, VS Code plugins, and any OpenAI-compatible clients... just point them all to one address. Silk automatically routes to the correct provider based on the model name.
- 🔄 Automatic Protocol Conversion — Send requests in OpenAI Chat format, and even Claude will respond correctly. Seamlessly convert between OpenAI Chat, Claude Messages, and OpenAI Responses protocols without memorizing three sets of API docs.
- 🛡️ Three-Level Failover — Upstream timeout → Auto-retry (exponential backoff) → Switch API Key → Switch Provider. Users remain unaware, and your AI experience stays uninterrupted.
- 🔐 Local-First, Privacy-Centric — All data is stored in a local SQLite database, and API keys are encrypted with AES-GCM. With no cloud components, you have full control over every request.
- 🔌 Pluggable Middleware — Gateway middleware loads on demand; turn off what you don't need (Token-saving extensions: coming soon).
- 🖥️ Graphical Management — Out-of-the-box desktop UI (Vue 3 + NaiveUI). Manage providers, routing rules, and view logs without writing a single line of configuration.

🔄 Protocol Support

Silk supports mutual conversion between three major protocols: OpenAI Chat (openai), Claude Messages (messages), and OpenAI Responses (responses). Requests entering via any protocol can be correctly forwarded to the upstream in the target format, with the response converted back to the client's protocol.

| Protocol               | Client Endpoint      | Status      |
| ---------------------- | -------------------- | ----------- |
| OpenAI Chat Completion | /v1/chat/completions | ✅ Supported |
| Claude Messages        | /v1/messages         | ✅ Supported |
| OpenAI Responses       | /v1/responses        | ✅ Supported |
| Gemini                 | —                    | 🚧 In Dev   |

Mutual conversion between the three protocols has been verified through practical debugging with OpenCode + Agnes (including streaming SSE and thinking process events). Gemini protocol conversion is still under development and will be added in future versions.

zh-CN.description: 一个本地端点，三大协议任意互转的桌面 AI 网关。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Silk 是一个运行在你桌面的 AI 多模型网关（Tauri 2 + Rust/Axum）。你在管理多个 AI 提供商时遇到的所有麻烦——协议不兼容、API Key 分散、一个限流整个服务挂掉——它用一个本地 HTTP 端点 http://127.0.0.1:1877 替你搞定。

✨ 功能亮点

- 🌐 统一接入 — 你的 ChatBox、LobeChat、VS Code 插件、OpenAI-compatible 客户端……所有工具指向一个地址就够了。Silk 根据模型名自动路由到正确的提供商
- 🔄 协议自动转换 — 用 OpenAI Chat 格式发请求，发给 Claude 也能正确响应。OpenAI Chat / Claude Messages / OpenAI Responses 三大协议任意互转，不用记三套 API 文档
- 🛡️ 三级失败回退 — 上游超时 → 自动重试（指数退避）→ 换一个 API Key → 换一个提供商。用户无感知，你的 AI 体验不中断
- 🔐 纯本地，隐私由你 — 所有数据存本地 SQLite，API Key 用 AES-GCM 加密，没有云端组件。你发的每个请求，你说了算
- 🔌 可插拔中间件 — 网关中间件按需加载，不想要就关掉（Token 节省类扩展功能：未来支持）
- 🖥️ 图形化管理 — 开箱即用的桌面 UI（Vue 3 + NaiveUI），管理提供商、路由规则、查看日志——不用写一行配置

🔄 协议支持

Silk 支持 OpenAI Chat（openai）、Claude Messages（messages）、OpenAI Responses（responses） 三大协议之间的相互转换，请求从任意协议进入，都能以目标协议格式正确转发到上游，响应再转换回客户端协议返回。

| 协议                   | 客户端端点           | 状态      |
| ---------------------- | -------------------- | --------- |
| OpenAI Chat Completion | /v1/chat/completions | ✅ 已支持  |
| Claude Messages        | /v1/messages         | ✅ 已支持  |
| OpenAI Responses       | /v1/responses        | ✅ 已支持  |
| Gemini                 | —                    | 🚧 开发中 |

三大协议互转已经 OpenCode + Agnes 实际联调验证（含流式 SSE 与思考过程事件）；Gemini 协议转换仍在开发中，后续版本接入。
